description: MUST-FAIL: a typed digest reference carried in the `cpb-refs` COSE protected header parameter cites an artifact type that declares more than one digest context, but omits `purpose`. §8.1 requires purpose to select exactly one context whenever more than one is declared; when it is absent and more than one context exists, the reference is unresolvable and the verifier MUST NOT report it as verified, regardless of carriage.

verification.note: multi-context-doc declares two digest contexts (identifier, content); the reference carries no purpose. §8.1: 'If type resolves to more than one digest context and purpose is absent ... the reference is unresolvable: the verifier MUST NOT guess a context and MUST NOT report the typed reference as verified.' This applies identically whether the reference is carried in the payload or, as here, in the cpb-refs header entry -- carriage does not change the resolution algorithm.

provenance: Authored for the cpb-03-typed-refs-envelope revision to exercise §8.1's multi-context/purpose-absent rule under envelope carriage. Not a fold of any external vector file.
